primary_releases.listing_title: Company Announcement • 26 November 2026 Alvotech to appeal US preliminary injunction decision relating to AVT05
primary_releases.original_title: Alvotech to appeal US preliminary injunction decision relating to AVT05
primary_releases.body_excerpt: Back Alvotech to appeal US preliminary injunction decision relating to AVT05 Company Announcement 26 November 2026 Alvotech intends to appeal the preliminary injunction and request an expedited hearing. The injunction relates to a single process patent that Alvotech believes it does not infringe and is confident to prevail on appeal. Alvotech still expects AVT05 to be one of the first US biosimilars to Simponi. The company’s order book and demand outlook remains strong, and Alvotech remains optimistic about its growth prospects. REYKJAVIK, Iceland, November 26, 2026 - Alvotech (NASDAQ: ALVO; A
